reason: An 8241-parameter temporal residual left the four frames nearly independent (0/8 baseline gate). A joint four-channel denoiser can represent cross-frame dependencies throughout the U-Net.
initialization: Copy all pretrained MNIST image UNet weights; average replicated four-frame input filters and replicate output filters; fine-tune all 1.5M parameters on four-frame moving-digit clips
data: MNIST train digit translated by one pixel per axis per frame, same deterministic affine generator as prior failed temporal-residual arm
sampling: 20-step stochastic DDIM, eta=1, cosine 1000-step schedule, t_min=20, predicted x0 clipped to [-1,1]
baseline_gate: At least 6/8 clips finite, ink 0.03-0.35, independent digit confidence >=0.7, independent frame-class consistency >=0.75, centroid movement >=0.5 pixels; inspect grid
if_gate_passes: Run predeclared video GRPO with separate adapter, frozen joint reference, group-relative reward, paired fresh evaluation and independent metrics
stop_rule: No GRPO unless baseline gate passes; stop training on nonfinite loss/gradients; no paid compute
